summary: First-finish smoke tests for LocalOps. Backend CRUD + stats verified via curl; frontend flows verified via Playwright: Home hero + CTAs, Dashboard load/table/stats/search/status-filter, Lead Detail nav, template switch (Standard/Busy/QuoteReady/SameDay have IDs standard|busy_callback|quote_ready|same_day), regenerate, copy button, status change via both pipeline step buttons and the Radix Select dropdown, reload persistence, delete with confirm dialog, Capture empty-submit validation (no POST fired), Capture valid-submit navigates to /leads/:id with new lead visible. All flows working.
passed: GET /api/stats returns {new:2, contacted:1, booked:1, lost:1, total:5}
POST /api/leads creates lead with server-generated id + received_time
Home hero title 'Recover missed contractor leads before they go cold.' visible with both CTAs
Dashboard loads with leads-table and 5 rows; stats card shows Total 5
Status filter dropdown filters to 'new' status (2 rows)
Lead-link navigates to /leads/:id and lead-detail-page renders
Template select switches textarea content (busy_callback tested)
Regenerate button refills textarea from selected template
Pipeline step (status-step-contacted) updates status via PATCH; persists after page reload
Radix status Select changes status to 'booked'
Delete flow: dialog opens, confirm deletes, navigates back to /dashboard, lead absent
Capture empty submit shows validation, no POST fired, stays on /capture
Capture valid submit POSTs to /api/leads and navigates to new /leads/:id
action_items: Minor note: template IDs in code are 'standard', 'busy_callback', 'quote_ready', 'same_day' — the review request listed them as 'Busy' etc. Not a bug; documentation-only discrepancy.
